integrity: The proof independently classifies every subgroup, proves an exact comparability criterion for permutability of q-containing subgroups, counts every permuting partner, and sums these counts over the subgroup lattice of H. Finite replay is used only as an independent check.
scientific_limitations: The kernel is cyclic of order p^a with a at least two.
The complement has prime order q dividing p-1 and acts faithfully.
Composite complements and general ZM-groups require additional subgroup strata.
The theorem gives the full relative function but does not classify accidental coincidences between distinct level values.
title: Relative subgroup commutativity for \(C_{p^a}\rtimes C_q\) Frobenius groups
